cells.gaps: The newest usable facts are dated 31 March 2021: ten police and gendarmerie units of Greater Conakry equipped with the SIPAO kit, with no total of units and no statement that any was entering records, and the digitising of procès-verbaux stated as an intention (C is that intention, not a record made). The decree of 13 May 2019 (GIN-008, GIN-009) creates the centre, the system and its budget allocation; it is a law, which places nothing, and it names no station. Nothing dated inside 36 months of the as-at shows preparation, a pilot or a system running, and governance (ministry as owner, a budget allocation in 2019 and a budget line in 2021) falls outside its window. The paper-only statements come from the excluded source (GIN-001 to GIN-003), so no dated statement of absence has been found.
cells.note: Not rung 2: the 2019 decree is a law and the 2021 equipping is an act of preparation older than 36 months, and no fact says the system ran, even in the capital. Not rung 1: the paper-only statement is from the excluded source alone.
